title: Osmosis
description: I took the role of team lead for this demo game developed for one of my university courses along with 5 other students. It was a valuable experience, as I got to learn how to organize and assign tasks, communicate, find solutions to unexpected problems and ensuring smooth development process. This is Osmosis - a demo game set in a fictional dystopian world, corrupted by capitalism and corporation. Through series of action gameplay loops and puzzles, you, the main characted, will set the other characters of this world free.
